(4) omp_pin.py:103-109 follows https->http redirects; the 600 s timeout is per read. (5) oracle_gateway_host.sh accepts a token file that derives a second oracle-ci, wedging check. (6) github.py:86 reads only 50 comments per thread, ignoring later Dispute replies. (7) report.py:294-308 prints duplicate disposition lines.
